Name: Pigeons Plus Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I received a request, and got permission, to update [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18770]Pigeons Plus[/url], so here it is!

This mod adds 5 types of pigeons and 4 types of doves. They produce feathers and eggs:

-Pigeon eggs can be hatched, or turned into mayo (you'll need 2 eggs cuz they're small).

-Down feathers can be collected and crafted into feather pillows, which the player will know by default. You'll need 6 feathers for that, plus a cloth.﻿ Feather pillows are a universal like. After all, who doesn't like a new soft fluffy pillow?

-White doves will also give you an olive branch at high friendship levels. Olive branches are a universal love

Enjoy!
